purpose: Auxiliary GraphRAG-Bench evidence-sentence surface diagnostic; not a per-unit estimate of the subgraph axis
scope_note: The analyzed units are evidence sentences paired with source relations, not gold subgraphs. The numeric result does not estimate C_subgraph.

rules.derivation: evidence sentence derived=1 iff majority (>=0.50) of content tokens of some evidence_relations string appear in normalized sentence; surface overlap only; conservative lower bound
rules.verbatim_copy: among derived, verbatim=1 iff token Jaccard>=0.90 OR substring either way between sentence and matched relation

census_reference.rubric: auto-generated from KG triples or templates

interpretation: Descriptive sentence-surface statistics only; not a verdict on the gold-subgraph provenance bin.
